reason: I already have an agent from Erbil who brings my stock and he has been fine with me for a long time. Paying 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 pair of shoes kills my margin when I resell, and half the time I can find something close in the Baghdad market today.
objection: Your fees are almost as much as the item itself, and you are new. My current agent knows me and gives me a better rate because I order in bulk. Why would I risk my stock with a company I have never heard of?
would_change_my_mind: A lower per-kilo rate for shop owners who order several kilos a month, and a trial order where I see the warehouse photos and the parcel arrives on time.
